name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A former accountant with a penchant for order, he initially joined a local rally team to manage their finances. However, his organizational skills quickly proved invaluable in coordinating logistics, streamlining transportation, and ensuring that equipment arrived on time and in perfect condition. His meticulous approach and understanding of complex supply chains caught the attention of AF Corse, who headhunted him to oversee their European operations.

At AF Corse, Ricardo thrives on the pressure of Grand Prix weekends. He excels at anticipating potential problems and implementing contingency plans. His colleagues know him as a stickler for detail, but also as a reliable and dedicated member of the team. Ricardo's distinctive talent lies in his ability to blend his financial acumen with a deep understanding of the logistical challenges inherent in motorsport, making him an exceptionally effective coordinator.

While most see the chaos of a race weekend, Ricardo sees a complex puzzle that needs solving. His goal is to make sure the drivers and engineers have everything they need, exactly when they need it, so they can focus on performance. To him, a perfectly executed logistics plan is just as satisfying as a race win.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly stocky build, reflecting years of dedicated work and a love for good food.

quirks: Insists on using a physical paper calendar in addition to digital tools.
Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized checklists.
Has a specific brand of Chilean coffee beans he insists on brewing every morning.
